[USER] User inquired about the cost of eco-friendly laundry detergents compared to regular detergents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eco-friendly laundry detergents generally tend to be more expensive than traditional detergents.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Eco-friendly detergents are often more concentrated, leading to potential long-term savings.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Initial costs might be higher, but eco-friendly detergents can lead to long-term savings by reducing waste and minimizing packaging.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Subscription services can provide discounts and convenience for eco-friendly brands.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Buying in bulk can reduce the cost per unit of eco-friendly detergents.
